title: Refraction of Light
content: When light passes through two media of different optical densities, the direction of light changes in passing from the first to the second medium[cite: 1].

title: Critical Angle
content: The angle of incidence corresponding to the angle of refraction $90^\circ$ is called the critical angle[cite: 1].

title: Total Internal Reflection
content: The phenomenon where light in one medium does not enter the optically less dense medium and is reflected back into the first medium for all angles of incidence greater than the critical angle[cite: 1].

title: Dispersion of Light
content: Splitting of white light into different colour-bands is called dispersion of light[cite: 1].

title: Spectrum
content: A band of different colours formed when a narrow pencil of white light passes through a prism and is split[cite: 1].
